paragraphs.text: Critical vulnerabilities in widely deployed infrastructure demand urgent remediation verification. CISA added N-able MailAssure to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog citing active exploitation, while Broadcom released patches for 23 VMware flaws including a critical authentication bypass in vCenter. Control owners must confirm affected asset inventories and patch deployment status across virtualized and email security platforms.

Identity-targeted campaigns and supplier breaches elevate access management and third-party risk. The Inception extortion group targets single sign-on credentials through vishing, Radware exposed customer cloud keys via an unsecured management API, and the EU Academy breach compromised personal data. Meanwhile, Iran-aligned Volant Manticore uses IPFS-based backdoors against telecommunications and critical infrastructure. Owners should validate privileged access controls, supplier assurance evidence, data protection monitoring, and detection coverage for novel command-and-control channels.
